title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
description: 175B parameters demonstrated emergent capabilities — arithmetic, translation, coding — without fine-tuning. In-context learning changed how we think about NLP. Started the LLM era.
authors: Brown, Mann, Ryder, Subbiah, Kaplan, Dhariwal, Neelakantan, Shyam, Sastry, Askell, Agarwal, et al.
